papers.title: Uneven Evolution of Cognition Across Generations of Generative AI Models
papers.reason: Excluded because it psychometrically evaluates the cognitive abilities of generative AI models rather than human participants.

papers.title: ASR-Agnostic Multimodal Spectrotemporal Modeling for Early Dementia Detection
papers.reason: The study develops a human dementia biomarker from elicited speech, but it includes no qualifying interactive decision task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: Demystifying Video Reasoning
papers.reason: Excluded because it investigates reasoning and working memory inside diffusion-based video generation models rather than human cognition.

papers.title: The Richest Paradigm You're Not Using: Commercial Videogames at the Intersection of Human-Computer Interaction and Cognitive Science
papers.reason: The perspective proposes interactive games, eye tracking, and behavioral timing for human executive-function research but reports no participant methodology that actually measures and analyzes these elements.

papers.title: Pupillometry and Brain Dynamics for Cognitive Load in Working Memory
papers.reason: Human participants perform a sequential Digit Span working-memory task while pupil dynamics are analyzed, although the EEG treatment is feature-based rather than detailed frequency-domain or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization
papers.reason: Excluded because it concerns KV-cache memory and autoregressive video generation rather than cognition in human participants.

papers.title: Cognitive Load Estimation Using Brain Foundation Models and Interpretability for BCIs
papers.reason: The paper addresses continuous human cognitive-load monitoring from EEG, but it reports foundation-model classification without a qualifying interactive paradigm or frequency-domain or connectivity methodology.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Computational Model of Brain-Heart Interactions via HRV and EEG Feature
papers.reason: The dataset includes an active working-memory task, but EEG is reduced to spectral band-power and generic features while the XGBoost and synthetic-signal models are not cognitive process models.

papers.title: Unveiling the Heart-Brain Connection: An Analysis of ECG in Cognitive Performance
papers.reason: Participants complete a working-memory paradigm, but the study centers on ECG-to-EEG feature projection and provides only band-level EEG features rather than qualifying connectivity or frequency-domain analysis.

papers.title: Your Eyes Controlled the Game: Real-Time Cognitive Training Adaptation based on Eye-Tracking and Physiological Data in Virtual Reality
papers.reason: Human participants perform adaptive sustained-attention and dual-task VR gameplay while eye-tracking data are centrally analyzed to estimate cognitive load and control difficulty.

papers.title: How Light Shapes Memory: Beta Synchrony in the Temporal-Parietal Cortex Predicts Cognitive Ergonomics for BCI Applications
papers.reason: The methodology combines active recall and sequence working-memory tasks with beta-phase EEG connectivity and regional synchrony analysis.

papers.title: Setting up for failure: automatic discovery of the neural mechanisms of cognitive errors
papers.reason: Excluded because its neural validation uses macaque data, so the study population is not restricted to human participants.

papers.title: A Quantitative Framework for Assessing Sleep Quality from EEG Time Series in Complex Dynamic Systems
papers.reason: The study analyzes human working-memory behavior alongside EEG power, connectivity, and cross-frequency phase-amplitude coupling as markers of sleep quality.

papers.title: Quantifying the Effects of Word Length, Frequency, and Predictability on Dyslexia
papers.reason: Eye tracking is central to the comparison of naturalistic reading behavior in dyslexic and typical readers, but reading is not presented as an interactive sequential decision task.

papers.title: Working Memory Functional Connectivity Analysis for Dementia Classification using EEG
papers.reason: AD, MCI, and control participants perform encoding, recall, and retrieval tasks while EEG phase-lag and entropy-based functional connectivity are analyzed for classification.

papers.title: Bayesian Distributional Models of Executive Functioning
papers.reason: Excluded because the evaluation uses controlled simulations and synthetically sampled sessions without a human participant population.

papers.title: Bibliometric-enhanced Systematic Literature Review of EEG in Education: Learning Concepts, Computational Methods, and Research Opportunities
papers.reason: The review surveys human EEG research on attention and learning but does not itself implement a qualifying behavioral, eye-tracking, EEG-connectivity, or cognitive-modeling methodology.

papers.title: EEG-Based Framework for Reflexive and Perceptual Assessment in CLIS: Preliminary Study in Healthy Volunteers
papers.reason: The healthy-volunteer study centrally analyzes frequency-tagged steady-state auditory and visual EEG responses, but its paradigms are passive rather than behaviorally interactive.

papers.title: EEG-Based Cognitive Load Classification During Landmark-Based VR Navigation
papers.reason: Participants actively navigate landmark-defined VR routes, but the summary provides classification results without qualifying EEG frequency-domain or connectivity methodology.

papers.title: A Unified Cortical Circuit Model with Divisive Normalization and Self-Excitation for Robust Representation and Memory Maintenance
papers.reason: Excluded because it is a theoretical neural-circuit study with simulated tasks and no human participant population.

papers.title: Dissociating Cognitive Load and Stress Responses Using Single-Channel EEG: Behavioral and Neural Correlates of Anxiety Across Cognitive States
papers.reason: The study assesses human cognitive load and stress, but the auditory protocol is not described as an interactive decision task and EEG analysis is limited to band-level and classifier-derived features.

papers.title: Sleep Brain and Cardiac Activity Predict Cognitive Flexibility and Conceptual Reasoning Using Deep Learning
papers.reason: Human executive performance is measured using the sequential Penn Conditional Exclusion Test, but the predictive inputs are passive sleep recordings with only EEG power-band summaries.

papers.title: Evaluating Cognitive Assessment Tools:A Comparative Analysis of MMSE, RUDAS, SAGE, ADAS and MoCA for Early Dementia Detection
papers.reason: The review concerns human dementia assessment but does not collect or analyze interactive behavioral trajectories, eye tracking, EEG, or computational cognitive models.

papers.title: Early Detection of Cognitive Impairment in Elderly using a Passive FPVS-EEG BCI and Machine Learning -- Extended Version
papers.reason: The paper targets early human cognitive-impairment detection, but its explicitly passive FPVS paradigm and CNN analysis provide neither behavioral interaction nor detailed frequency-domain or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: Immersive Virtual Reality Assessments of Working Memory and Psychomotor Skills: A Comparison between Immersive and Non-Immersive Assessments
papers.reason: Participants complete sequential working-memory and reaction-time assessments in VR and PC formats, but no eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or cognitive process model is included.

papers.title: Triangulating LLM Progress through Benchmarks, Games, and Cognitive Tests
papers.reason: Excluded because the games and cognitive tests are used to evaluate LLM abilities rather than human participants.

papers.title: Interactive Virtual Games: Winners for Deep Cognitive Assessment
papers.reason: A clinical human sample completes interactive executive-function minigames with continuous behavioral and gaze-trajectory analysis for psychometric assessment and strategy profiling.

papers.title: Mazed and Confused: A Dataset of Cybersickness, Working Memory, Mental Load, Physical Load, and Attention During a Real Walking Task in VR
papers.reason: Participants actively navigate VR mazes and perform attention and working-memory tasks while eye-tracking features are recorded and analyzed for state classification.

papers.title: Pathformer3D: A 3D Scanpath Transformer for 360° Images
papers.reason: The model is evaluated on human panoramic eye-tracking datasets and directly predicts fixation sequences, but the underlying image-viewing condition is passive and the model is not a cognitive generative process model.

papers.title: Transcranial low-level laser stimulation in near infrared-II region for brain safety and protection
papers.reason: The human safety study includes EEG and executive-function assessments only as broad outcome measures without a specified interactive task or qualifying EEG frequency-domain or connectivity analysis.
